original_target.title: Does fixed noise select a unique inviscid fluid law?
original_target.area: Nonlinear waves, fluids and kinetic equations

scope_comparison: Actual1712.09830 Openproblem4(a) asks sequence dependence at fixed noise. Current2602.15805v2 studies an N-dimensional Galerkin evolution with extra random stirring and convergence of two energy/enstrophy observables, not the full untruncated velocity stationary law for fixed Laplacian/noise. Altering viscosity exponent also does not answer fixed operator.
